snapshot.method: SciPy adaptive cubature after a standard simplex-to-cube coordinate change
snapshot.derivation: Shift k=q+P. The kz term integrates to zero because g0z=0. The surviving -Pz times k0^0,k0^2,k0^4 terms have Gamma(5)-weighted Gaussian integrals -2/F^3,+1/(2F^2),-3/(4F), respectively. Binomial coefficients give the displayed integrand.
snapshot.pole_argument: The only rank-six UV term is k0^5*kz, whose angular integral vanishes. Lower Gaussian moments are UV finite; positive F excludes IR singularities. All UV/IR Laurent slots vanish for this monomial.
snapshot.positive_f_bound: F>=min(m_i^2)-x4*(1-x4)>=4-1/4=3.75; the spatial variance terms are nonnegative.
snapshot.native_conversion: Native finite coefficient is i*pi^2 times the real OneLoop integral; no pole normalization terms occur.
snapshot.qualification: Independent numerical quadrature with estimated errors and convergence checks, not an interval-certified bound or a performance benchmark.
Independent shifted-scalar definition audit; no performance claim
snapshot.convention: J_h = native IREGI / (i*pi^(2+h)); finite UV/IR-free points

Ordinary D4 and coalesced D4/D6 normalization checks pass. Finite-interval ordinary-D4 mass-shift integration plus an independently integrated tail agrees with direct D6 integration.

snapshot.scope: Read retained JSON and independently reconstruct gate decisions and paired ratios; no bootstrap resampling, corrected analyzer, numerical kernel, build or timing rerun.
snapshot.interpretation: This is explicitly a posthoc admission correction, not a preregistered protocol result or production adoption. Full no-regression acceptance remains unmet.

snapshot.scope: Narrow posthoc per-family terminal admission correction; read-only source and retained mutation-evidence review. No corrected real-cohort analyzer, numerical kernel, build or timing was executed by this reviewer.
reviewed_properties: Only completed and genuinely short-block-inconclusive rows are accepted; all eight coordinates and all48 complete quartets remain mandatory.
Stored row and aggregate statuses are derived from raw acceptance durations, exact shared counts and fixed orders; unknown or unexplained failures remain disqualifying.
Global error/guard/hash fields, cleanup failures, timeouts, child failures, malformed or nonmonotonic elapsed times and failed initialization/controls remain rejected.
All original source/raw/initialization accounting, numerical comparison, exact own snapshots, COLLIER checks and calibration validation remain in the candidate main path.
The short family retains all five inconclusive ratios; the other seven families still require complete individual numerical admission and the unchanged statistical width rule.

ratio and summarize_family are independently AST-identical to the frozen analyzer; all observed family data and every ratio statistic except gate labels must equal the frozen summary before writing a new result.
Original source, raw data, receipt and summary remain immutable; revised output is separately named and explicitly labeled posthoc, not preregistered.
snapshot.execution_recommendation: ONE saved-data revised analysis may proceed under ROOT authorization, with before/after source/raw bindings retained. No new numerical run, timing retry, omission, threshold change or adoption follows.
